class_guess: Binary counter with re-pairing overflow: kill #11's table, mirrored and started in #11's D
summary: Kill #11's table mirrored, started in D: same binary counter; a 215-step init lands in #11's proved invariant
mechanism: Same table as our kill #11 `1RB0LE_1RC0RC_1LD0RB_1LA0LE_1LD1LF_1LD---`: mirror it and rename A,B,C,D -> B,C,D,A (E, F fixed). This machine starts in #11's D.
Tape K = `0^inf <C (01)^b 000 (01)^a` + digits `(10)^v [00] (01)^u` + `1001`: a binary counter. M_k carries to the last 0-bit (ruler depths); O re-pairs every digit when all bits are 1.
From blank, 215 steps reach K((1,1,3); 4, 1), class A of #11's invariant. The real run equals M_k/O exactly for all 18,976 macro steps to 1e9, every K in INV.

history.skeleton: 0^inf <C (01)^b 000 (01)^a [(10)^v_j (01)^u_j]_{j=m..1} 1001 0^inf  (all bits 1: the K just before each overflow)

rules.name: init (blank -> first INV state)
rules.cases: = K((1,1,3); a=4, b=1), class A. Passes K(; 3, 1) at step 82 (no digits, not in INV). Exact on #33 by direct simulation

rules.name: M_k carry (k = trailing 1-bits)
rules.cases: j* = last bit-0 digit, k = m - j*; k = 0..5 tested, 61 of them with v = 1 (the digit drops: same string, re-read). Needs v >= 1, u_j, v_j >= 1 for j > j*, a, b >= 0

rules.name: O overflow (all bits 1)
rules.cases: m = 1..7 tested; needs m >= 1, all u_j, v_j >= 1, a >= 1. New digits (#11 notation): (0,0,u_1), (v_(j-1)-1, 0, u_j), (v_m, 1, a)

rules.to: S1m <C 01, S3m 01 A>, T9m <C 0001001, T12m 10110 E> (full list in notes.md)
rules.cases: Exact window check on #33's table (head never reads outside the window); F entered only in T4m, T9m, T13m, always reading 0. M and O are #11's chains of these, mirrored

template.diff: 0 transitions after mirroring + renaming (#11's A,B,C,D,E,F = this machine's B,C,D,A,E,F); only the start state differs (#11's D)
template.note: Same table, so #11's rules (M, O, the 20 window lemmas) and its Rocq-checked invariant INV = Common and (A or B or C) carry over unchanged. Only the init is new: 215 steps to K((1,1,3);4,1), class A. SBCv6 TM21 / TCv3 (targeting.md) are only loose relatives.

strategy: Reuse kill #11 wholesale: copy its .v and mirror it (states A,B,C,D -> B,C,D,A; tape sides swapped). Replace init (483 steps to K [d1 1 2] 8 5) with 215 steps to K [d1 1 3] 4 1, check INV there by computation, keep the closure proof verbatim. Alternative: keep tm11's lemmas and transport with busycoq's Flip.v + Permute.v.
risks: Mirroring 692 lines by hand is error-prone; script it (swap <*/*>, {{X}}>/<{{X}}, rename states) and let Rocq check. Flip/Permute route adds a second TM_from_str (check_kill warns).
Duplicate work: hipparcos's Level-1 machine is the B-start of this table (same open question as #11).
Proof size is small (init + INV check on top of #11), so the main cost is the mechanical port.
